name.en: Federal Highway 101 (Matamoros–Ciudad Victoria–San Luis Potosí line)
name.zh: 101 号联邦公路（马塔莫罗斯—维多利亚城—圣路易斯波托西州界）

aka.zh: 维多利亚城—马塔莫罗斯公路

aka.en: Carretera Victoria–Tula, or the old Jaumave road, west of the state capital
aka.zh: 维多利亚城—图拉公路，州府以西一段亦称“豪马韦老路”

aka.en: “La carretera de la muerte” (the Highway of Death), in the press after 2010
aka.zh: “死亡公路”（2010 年后媒体的称呼）

tagline.en: Tamaulipas's road from the Rio Grande delta over the Sierra Madre to the plateau, begun by convict labour in 1898 and known after 2010 for the massacres at San Fernando
tagline.zh: 塔毛利帕斯州自格兰德河三角洲翻越马德雷山、通往高原的公路：1898 年由囚犯开始修筑，2010 年后因圣费尔南多的屠杀事件而为人所知

start.en: The junction with Federal Highway 80 near La Viga, just inside San Luis Potosí, south-west of Tula
start.zh: 图拉西南、刚进入圣路易斯波托西州境内的拉比加附近，与 80 号联邦公路交会处

end.en: Matamoros, Tamaulipas, at the junction with Federal Highway 2 near the border with Brownsville, Texas
end.zh: 塔毛利帕斯州马塔莫罗斯，邻近与美国得克萨斯州布朗斯维尔的边界，与 2 号联邦公路交会处

en: Federal Highway 101 crosses Tamaulipas from north-east to south-west. From Matamoros it runs south over the coastal plain by the junctions with Highway 97 and Highway 180 at La Coma, through San Fernando, Santander Jiménez, Nuevo Padilla and Güémez to Ciudad Victoria, the state capital, then climbs west over the Sierra Madre Oriental by Jaumave, Palmillas and Tula to meet Highway 80 just over the San Luis Potosí line. Spanish Wikipedia gives it 500 km, 498 of them in Tamaulipas; English Wikipedia, from the 2011 road data, 492 km.

The Victoria–Matamoros half is the state's main road between its capital and the border; the federal road data list it as MEX-101-180, under both numbers. Spanish-language press describes it as the best known road in Tamaulipas, and English Wikipedia as the state's most important transport link in normal times.
zh: 101 号联邦公路自东北向西南斜穿塔毛利帕斯州。它从马塔莫罗斯出发，向南穿越沿海平原，经过与 97 号公路的交会点以及与 180 号公路相交的拉科马，经圣费尔南多、桑坦德希门尼斯、新帕迪利亚和圭梅斯到达州府维多利亚城，然后向西经豪马韦、帕尔米利亚斯和图拉翻越东马德雷山脉，在刚过圣路易斯波托西州界处与 80 号公路相接。西班牙语维基百科给出全长 500 公里，其中 498 公里在塔毛利帕斯；英语维基百科依据 2011 年道路数据给出 492 公里。
维多利亚城—马塔莫罗斯这一半是该州首府与边境之间的主要道路；联邦道路数据将其列为 MEX-101-180，即两个编号共用。西班牙语媒体称它是塔毛利帕斯最知名的道路，英语维基百科则称它在平常时期是该州最重要的交通线。

en: The mountain section is the oldest. According to a 2020 column in the Gaceta de Tamaulipas drawing on the work of Ciudad Victoria's chroniclers, Governor Guadalupe Mainero was building the Victoria–Tula road as an earth track with convict labour in 1898: during that year's epidemic all the prisoners of the state jail were moved to the camp at La Reforma in the Jaumave sierra while the jail was disinfected. The same column says convicts were still sheltered in camps at night while working with pick and shovel on the Tula road during the influenza of 1918.

Local money paid for much of it. In January 1961 the state congress extended by three years the levies collected in Victoria, Jaumave, Palmillas, Tula and other municipalities 'as the contribution of private citizens' to the building of the Victoria–Tula and Victoria–Soto la Marina roads. By 1989 the federal table of bus routes gave Ciudad Victoria–Matamoros as 311 km.

In 2010 the road became a byword for violence. On the night of 22 August 2010 three vans carrying 75 or 77 migrants from Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Ecuador, Brazil and India were stopped by Los Zetas on the road between Ciudad Victoria and San Fernando; the migrants were taken to an abandoned building at the ejido of El Huizachal, and 58 men and 14 women were shot when they refused to join the group. Marines found the bodies on 24 August after a survivor walked along the highway to a checkpoint. In April and May 2011, 196 bodies were recovered from 48 clandestine graves at San Fernando; many of the victims had been taken from buses travelling to the border, and the state government told the national human rights commission, CNDH, that the abductions had taken place in San Fernando and on federal Highway 101. El Universal reported in April 2011 that bus lines were routing around the road.
zh: 山区段最为古老。据《塔毛利帕斯公报》2020 年一篇依据维多利亚城地方史家研究写成的专栏，1898 年州长瓜达卢佩·马伊内罗正用囚犯劳力修建维多利亚城—图拉土路：那一年发生疫情，州监狱消毒期间，全部囚犯被转移到豪马韦山区的拉雷福尔马营地。该专栏还说，1918 年流感期间，仍有囚犯白天在通往图拉的路上用镐和铁锹干活，夜里被安置在营地。
这条路的很大一部分靠地方资金修成。1961 年 1 月，州议会将维多利亚、豪马韦、帕尔米利亚斯、图拉等市镇征收的税费延长三年，作为“私人的出资”，用于修建维多利亚城—图拉和维多利亚城—索托拉马里纳公路。到 1989 年，联邦客运线路表给出的维多利亚城—马塔莫罗斯里程为 311 公里。

2010 年，这条路成了暴力的代名词。2010 年 8 月 22 日夜间，载有 75 或 77 名来自危地马拉、洪都拉斯、萨尔瓦多、厄瓜多尔、巴西和印度移民的三辆面包车，在维多利亚城与圣费尔南多之间的公路上被“洛斯塞塔斯”拦截；移民被带到埃尔维萨查尔村社一处废弃建筑，因拒绝加入该组织，58 名男子和 14 名女子遭枪杀。一名幸存者沿公路走到检查站报案后，海军于 8 月 24 日找到遗体。2011 年 4 月至 5 月，圣费尔南多 48 处秘密墓坑中共挖出 196 具遗体；许多遇害者是从开往边境的客车上被劫走的，州政府向国家人权委员会（CNDH）报告称，绑架发生在圣费尔南多城区和 101 号联邦公路上。《环球报》2011 年 4 月报道，客运公司纷纷绕开这条公路。

en: The road has had little money. In August 2026 the state's public works secretary called the federal ministry's allocation of more than 2,000 million pesos for Tamaulipas's federal roads a record after years of neglected upkeep, with Victoria–Matamoros among the stretches to get deep patching and maintenance. The ministry's delegate has told the construction chamber CMIC that widening Victoria–Matamoros to four lanes is being studied, with the investment not yet defined, according to Milenio.
zh: 这条路长期缺钱。2026 年 8 月，州公共工程厅长称，联邦交通部为塔毛利帕斯联邦公路拨付的逾 20 亿比索是多年养护荒废之后的“创纪录投资”，维多利亚城—马塔莫罗斯段是将进行深度补坑和养护的路段之一。据《千年报》报道，交通部驻州代表曾向墨西哥建筑业商会（CMIC）表示，正在研究将维多利亚城—马塔莫罗斯段拓宽为四车道，投资额尚未确定。

value.en: 500 km, 498 in Tamaulipas and 2 in San Luis Potosí (Spanish Wikipedia); 492 km, from the 2011 Datos Viales, as cited in English Wikipedia. Ciudad Victoria–Matamoros: 311 km in the 1989 federal bus-route table.
value.zh: 500 公里，其中塔毛利帕斯 498 公里、圣路易斯波托西 2 公里（西班牙语维基百科）；492 公里，出自 2011 年《道路数据》，据英语维基百科引述。维多利亚城—马塔莫罗斯：1989 年联邦客运线路表作 311 公里。

figures.source: Spanish Wikipedia, Carretera Federal 101; SCT, Datos Viales de Tamaulipas 2011, as cited in English Wikipedia, Mexican Federal Highway 101; DOF, Cuadro de Rutas y Servicios del Autotransporte Federal, 2 February 1989

why.en: No public figure. The road was built over decades, the mountain section beginning as a convict-built track in 1898 and partly paid for later by local levies; no source found states a cost.
why.zh: 无公开数据。这条路历经数十年修成：山区段始于 1898 年囚犯修筑的土路，后来部分由地方税费出资；未找到任何说明造价的资料。

value.en: The state of Tamaulipas, using convict labour from 1898; local levies in the municipalities along the Victoria–Tula road, extended by decree in 1961; and the federal government, which maintains it as a toll-free federal road
value.zh: 塔毛利帕斯州（1898 年起使用囚犯劳力）；维多利亚城—图拉公路沿线各市镇的地方税费（1961 年经法令延期）；以及联邦政府——如今作为免费联邦公路由其养护

figures.source: Gaceta de Tamaulipas, Los reos a ‘la sierra de Jaumave’, March 2020; Periódico Oficial del Estado de Tamaulipas, 4 January 1961, Decreto No. 401

value.en: 72 migrants killed on 22–23 August 2010 after being taken from vans on the road; 196 bodies in 48 clandestine graves found in April and May 2011, many of them bus passengers abducted on Highway 101. The CNDH issued Recommendations 80/2013 and 23VG/2019.
value.zh: 2010 年 8 月 22—23 日，72 名移民在公路上被从面包车中劫走后遇害；2011 年 4 月至 5 月发现 48 处秘密墓坑、196 具遗体，其中许多是在 101 号公路上被劫持的客车乘客。国家人权委员会为此发布第 80/2013 号和第 23VG/2019 号建议书。

figures.source: CNDH, Masacre de los 72 migrantes en Tamaulipas, August 2025; CNDH, Recomendación por Violaciones Graves 23VG/2019

timeline.en: Governor Guadalupe Mainero is building the Victoria–Tula track with convict labour, by a local column's account.
timeline.zh: 据一篇地方专栏记载，州长瓜达卢佩·马伊内罗正用囚犯劳力修筑维多利亚城—图拉土路。

timeline.en: Convicts are still working on the Tula road during the influenza epidemic, by the same account.
timeline.zh: 据同一记载，流感流行期间仍有囚犯在通往图拉的路上施工。

timeline.en: The state congress extends for three years the local levies paying for the Victoria–Tula road.
timeline.zh: 州议会将用于修建维多利亚城—图拉公路的地方税费延长三年。

timeline.en: On 22–23 August, 72 migrants taken from vans on the road are murdered at San Fernando.
timeline.zh: 8 月 22—23 日，72 名在公路上被从面包车中劫走的移民在圣费尔南多遇害。

timeline.en: From April, 48 clandestine graves holding 196 bodies are found at San Fernando; bus lines avoid the road.
timeline.zh: 4 月起，圣费尔南多发现 48 处秘密墓坑、196 具遗体；客运公司绕开这条公路。

timeline.en: The CNDH issues Recommendation 80/2013 on the massacre of the 72 on 23 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 23 日，国家人权委员会就 72 人遇害事件发布第 80/2013 号建议书。

timeline.en: The CNDH issues Recommendation 23VG/2019 on the San Fernando graves.
timeline.zh: 国家人权委员会就圣费尔南多墓坑发布第 23VG/2019 号建议书。

timeline.en: More than 2,000 million pesos are assigned to Tamaulipas's federal roads, Victoria–Matamoros among them.
timeline.zh: 塔毛利帕斯联邦公路获拨逾 20 亿比索，维多利亚城—马塔莫罗斯段在列。
